note: Nepal's largest banks include Nabil, Global IME, NIC Asia and the state-owned Nepal Bank. Nabil's card page sits behind Cloudflare (not passed), NIC Asia's card URL answers 404 and Global IME's site didn't answer (2026-10-30), so Nepal Bank Limited, this file's bank since 2026-10-29, is written alone. Nepal Bank Limited's credit card page (read again 2026-10-30): its Visa domestic credit card (valid only in Nepal, India and Bhutan) charges 2% a month (24% a year) on purchases and on cash; a joining fee of 750 rupees (now written as the issue fee) and an annual fee of 750; a payment of 10% of the outstanding, at least 1,000 rupees, written as the minimum; 15 to 45 days free of interest on purchases, written as 45; a late payment 300 rupees each time; over the limit 500 rupees; a cash withdrawal 100 rupees at the bank's own ATMs (200 at other Visa ATMs and 250 in India, not written). The page states no foreign-transaction fee (the card works in India and Bhutan too) and none is written. Wave 4 (2026-10-30): NMB Bank, a large commercial bank whose standard tariff prices its credit cards, is added; NIC Asia's, Global IME's and Himalayan Bank's sites didn't answer this time, Sanima's home page links no tariff this research found, and Everest Bank's wasn't pursued (2026-10-30). NMB Bank's standard tariff of charges (effective 17 September 2026, read 2026-10-30): the VISA Credit Card's joining fee of 1,000 rupees (written as the issue fee) and its yearly fee of 1,000 (or 5,000 for the card's five years); the Platinum card's first year free, then 2,000 a year (or 8,000); interest 2.50% a month in the first billing cycle, 2.75% in the second and 3% from the third, written as 2.50% a month (the later steps aren't written); a cash withdrawal at NMB's ATMs 100 rupees or 2%, whichever is higher (200 or 2% at other banks', and 300 or 4% in India, not written); a late payment 2.5% of the minimum due or 500 rupees, whichever is higher, each month; over the limit 500. The tariff states no minimum payment, grace period or foreign-transaction fee for the credit cards; the corporate card isn't written.
